recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future redesign changes the module diagram level labels themselves.
issue_request: FHIR-33977 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the FHIR-core Getting Started modules page. It asked to replace confusing diagram-position wording for the three module groups with the diagram's explicit level labels: Infrastructure (Level 1 and Level 2), Content (Level 3 and Level 4), and Reasoning (Level 5).
initial_application: Historical commit dfb07285cbc2261914990d8de6a9ac750a96d594 applied the issue by changing source/modules.html from the old bottom/middle/top rung and row wording to the requested level-label wording. That source-changing commit is already an ancestor of the combined branch.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes modules.html as the Getting Started page, while source/modules-fragment.html labels the diagram levels from Level 1 through Level 5. FHIR-I WGM 202205 Confluence minutes record FHIR-33977 as Persuasive with Mod, and bounded Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/modules.html currently says Infrastructure (Level 1 and Level 2), Content (Level 3 and Level 4), and Reasoning (Level 5), and searches of the relevant source files found no remaining old bottom/top rung wording.
